Kinematics Formula Sheet
1. Relative Velocity of a Kinematic Link
Relative Velocity:
    V_B = V_A + V_{B/A}
For rotating link:
    V = omega × r
(omega = angular velocity, r = distance from center)
2. Rubbing Velocity at Pin Joint
Rubbing Velocity:
    V_rubbing = r × |omega1 - omega2|
3. Coriolis Acceleration
Coriolis Acceleration:
    a_C = 2 × omega × V_r
Where:
    omega = angular velocity of rotating link
    V_r = velocity of sliding point
4. Velocity Diagram (Relative Velocity Method)
For rotating links:
    V = omega × r (perpendicular to link)
For sliders:
    Velocity is along sliding direction.
Kinematics Formula Sheet
5. Acceleration Components
Radial (centripetal) Acceleration:
    a_r = omega^2 × r
Tangential Acceleration:
    a_t = alpha × r
Total Acceleration:
    a = a_r (toward center) + a_t (perpendicular to link)
6. Particle Kinematics in Cartesian Coordinates
Position:
    r = x i + y j + z k
Velocity:
    v = dr/dt = dx/dt i + dy/dt j + dz/dt k
Acceleration:
    a = dv/dt = d²x/dt² i + d²y/dt² j + d²z/dt² k
7. Cylindrical Coordinates (Curvilinear Motion)
Velocity:
    v = r_dot e_r + r theta_dot e_theta + z_dot k
Acceleration:
    a = (r_double_dot - r theta_dot^2) e_r + (r theta_double_dot + 2 r_dot theta_dot) e_theta + z_double_dot k
Kinematics Formula Sheet
8. General Plane Motion of Rigid Bodies
Velocity of point P:
    V_P = V_A + omega × r_{P/A}
Acceleration of point P:
    a_P = a_A + alpha × r_{P/A} - omega^2 r (radial component)
9. Rotation in 3D
Advanced applications use angular velocity vector and Euler angles.
Example: Satellite, gyroscope, drone rotation.
